name: mri-vscode
description: Surfaces MRI analysis inline: risk scores, blast radius, and fail-closed guard checks while you edit.

commands.title: MRI: Refresh analysis for this workspace
MRI: Show blast radius for this function

mri.entryPoint.markdownDescription: Absolute path to MRI's CLI entry point (`dist/cli/index.js`). Leave empty to auto-detect: the workspace itself, a sibling `../mri` checkout, then `mri` on PATH.

mri.churnWindowDays.description: Git churn window (days) used for risk scoring.

mri.codeLensEnabled.description: Show risk score and blast-radius CodeLenses above functions/classes.

mri.autoRefreshOnSave.description: Re-run MRI analysis when a file is saved (debounced), instead of on every keystroke.

mri.guardResourcesPath.description: Optional absolute path to a guard resource-grant JSON config passed as --resources.
